test_description: Verify that ingestSpawnedChildrenFromRunstate() can discover spawned children persisted by RunStateManager, proving both components use the same runstate.json path
test_assertions: ingestSpawnedChildrenFromRunstate() reads from the same path without executions/ indirection
Spawned children are correctly discovered after being persisted by the DAG runner
change_description: Align ingestSpawnedChildrenFromRunstate() to read runstate.json from .converge/journal/{playbook}/runstate.json (same path used by RunStateManager) instead of the non-existent executions/ subdirectory
why_this_correction: Correctness fix: evidence from the observe phase shows the navigator silently fails to discover spawned children due to a path mismatch between dag-tree.ts:335 and run-state-manager.ts:48. This ranks above the journal-boundary finding (prevention, rubric #2) because it causes actual wrong behavior today, and above the documentation finding (clarity, rubric #4) which has no runtime impact.
